owner_preregistration_draft.document_title: GUARDIAN ALPHA V30 — PROSPECTIVE EVALUATION SCIENTIFIC PREREGISTRATION

preregistration_text.section_1_experimental_charter: This document constitutes the irrevocable scientific preregistration protocol for the prospective, out-of-sample evaluation of Guardian Alpha Candidate D2 against Frozen Baseline E0. Historical optimization is permanently closed. No parameters, thresholds, or universes may be modified during the prospective evaluation.
preregistration_text.section_3_causal_session_eligibility: A trading session T is defined as an eligible prospective defensive session if and only if the strategy regime signal computed at the market close of session T-1 (using data strictly <= T-1) allocated D2 into its defensive cash cushion sleeve (risk_on is False or winners is empty). Conditioning on same-day negative returns R_{m,T} < 0 is strictly recognized as a secondary descriptive partition, not the primary causal endpoint.

section_4_primary_statistical_endpoint.metric: d_t = max(0, -R_{E0,t}) - max(0, -R_{D2,t}) on eligible defensive sessions
section_4_primary_statistical_endpoint.primary_hurdle: Reject H0: E[d_t | I_{def,t}^{causal}=1] <= 0.0010 (10 bps/day) at alpha = 0.05
section_4_primary_statistical_endpoint.inferential_tests: Both Newey-West HAC (Bartlett kernel, lag q = floor(4*(N/100)^(2/9))) and Stationary Block Bootstrap (B=10,000, seed=20261025) must achieve p < 0.05.

preregistration_text.section_5_secondary_risk_budget_guardrai: Full-period Delta CAGR = CAGR_{D2} - CAGR_{E0} >= -0.0200 (-200 bps annualized). This is formally agreed to be an operational risk-budget guardrail, not a statistically validated non-inferiority proof.
preregistration_text.section_6_horizon_and_extension_rules: The nominal evaluation duration is exactly 252 prospective trading sessions. If the number of causal defensive sessions N_{def}^{causal} < 30 at session 252, data collection automatically extends session-by-session until N_{def}^{causal} = 30 or total sessions reach 504. If N_{def}^{causal} < 30 at session 504, the trial terminates as INCONCLUSIVE. Interim optional stopping for statistical significance is strictly forbidden.
preregistration_text.section_7_catastrophic_safety_circuit_br: If at any point during prospective evaluation D2's maximum drawdown exceeds E0's maximum drawdown by more than 300 basis points (+0.0300), the trial halts immediately and Candidate D2 is formally REJECTED.
preregistration_text.section_8_fail_closed_governance: The system will operate under a fail-closed model. Any unhandled exception or reconciliation failure triggers an INCIDENT_LOCK requiring human clearance. No automated restart may clear locks or place orders.

section_9_owner_execution_block.declaration: I, the repository owner, hereby ratify the above protocol and confirm that I have verified my market data subscription rights, including non-display and post-termination data obligations.
